summary: Games for kids to learn all about snails, worms, scorpions and many more
description:
The Bugs 2: What Are They Like? is a fun, educational app where children can explore the fascinating world of bugs beyond insects — including spiders, worms, snails, scorpions, centipedes and more! Through interactive games, beautiful animations, real videos, and narrated explanations, kids will learn how these amazing creatures live, move, hunt, and grow.

This is the perfect companion to the acclaimed app “The Bugs I: Insects”, taking the experience further into the strange and wonderful world of invertebrates.

🌿 Discover bugs like never before
How does a spider build its web? How many legs does a centipede have? Can a scorpion be dangerous? How long does it take a snail to cross a garden?

Through simple texts, rich visuals, and hands-on interaction, The Bugs 2 answers these questions and many more — helping children connect with nature while learning fascinating facts about the smallest creatures on Earth.

🧠 Educational and playful
Children learn best by doing, and this app is full of opportunities for exploration:

🎮 No rules, no stress, no time limits — just pure discovery
🔍 Observe each bug's unique traits and behaviors
🎨 Interact with them through storytelling and games
🎧 Listen to narrated facts that make learning fun for early readers
✨ Key Features
🕷️ Learn about spiders, worms, snails, scorpions, centipedes and more
🐌 Discover curious facts: hunting methods, reproduction, movement, and defense
🎮 Play dozens of educational mini-games: create your own bug, classify creatures, help worms dig, spot camouflaged spiders and more
📸 Enjoy real videos and illustrations that bring each bug to life
🔊 Fully narrated — great for pre-readers and early readers
👶 Content suitable for children aged 3+
🚫 100% ad-free, safe and child-friendly
🌏 Why choose “The Bugs 2: What Are They Like?”
Sparks curiosity about nature and science
Encourages observation, critical thinking and empathy for living creatures
Expands on insect knowledge with new invertebrate families
Ideal for homes and classrooms — fun for the whole family
Designed with love by educators, artists and developers
This app invites children to discover and care for the tiny creatures that make our ecosystems thrive — all while playing and having fun.
